title: Bubble Peony Selfie
description: A young woman with black hair and white headphones stands in a gym-like setting, taking a selfie with a smartphone on a selfie stick. She wears a white tank top, red shorts, and white sneakers, positioned beside a giant transparent bubble containing a large purple peony flower, surrounded by smaller bubbles, colorful fish, and floating red petals.
prompt: A young Asian woman with black hair wearing white headphones, white tank top and red athletic shorts stands confidently taking a selfie with a long selfie stick in a surreal gym environment. A massive transparent bubble beside her contains a giant blooming purple peony with orange center. Colorful fish swim around, red petals float in the air, dumbbells and gym equipment visible in background, pink floor with rocks and succulents, vibrant whimsical atmosphere.
